criteria.reason: Verification commands pass, but PATCH.diff includes forbidden .signoff control artifacts, so this sealed patch cannot satisfy the scoped acceptance contract.

findings.claim: PATCH.diff includes forbidden .signoff deletions even though the active contract allows only .gitignore and package-lock.json.
findings.evidence: The sealed patch contains deletions under .signoff/** while EVIDENCE.json reports only .gitignore and package-lock.json in scope.
